# Testing the compiler

Build and run the full test suite with:

```sh
./build.sh
```

The build regenerates token and operator metadata, builds `edva` via `make edva`,
and runs `run_tests.sh`. `run_tests.sh` checks generator freshness, driver
behavior, examples, passing programs, and expected-failure programs.

## Focused checks

Always wrap ad-hoc test executions in explicit timeouts and 4 GB RAM limits (`ulimit -v 4194304`):

Run a passing integration case directly:

```sh
bash -c 'ulimit -v 4194304; timeout 10s ./edva tests/pass/04_choice_inline.dva -r'
```

For a failure case, verify that compilation exits nonzero with the expected diagnostic:

```sh
bash -c 'ulimit -v 4194304; timeout 10s ./edva tests/fail/17_middle_bare_pipe_choice.dva'
```

Use the module directory itself for a multi-file test:

```sh
bash -c 'ulimit -v 4194304; timeout 10s ./edva tests/pass/28_modules -r'
```

## Driver regression suite

Run the driver suite alone when modifying CLI flags, module loading, or code generation modes:

```sh
bash -c 'ulimit -v 4194304; timeout 120s ./selfhost/test_driver.sh'
```

`selfhost/test_driver.sh` verifies real end-to-end driver behaviors across 9 regression gates:
1. Parse failure propagation (fails with `E2064`, emits no outputs)
2. Missing module failure propagation (fails with `E5006`, emits no outputs)
3. Unwritable output path error handling (`E5012`, no segfault)
4. Exact file byte reading & empty file handling
5. Child signal termination reporting under `-r` (`E5014`)
6. Typed AST elaboration & tree dump (`--typed-ast`, `-typed-ast-tree`)
7. C header generation from `#export` (`-H` / `--header`)
8. WebAssembly target compilation and Node.js execution (`-target wasm32-unknown-unknown`)
9. Modular compilation (`-c`, `--module`, `--entry`) & interface-only `#use` dependency isolation
